title: Prepositions & Articles
description: Common prepositions with time, place, and fixed collocations; articles

prepositions_time: Ali hasn't seen his friend for ages.
Jawad has lived here since September.
I have studied math for an hour.
We have known each other since we were kids.
The meeting will be held on April 18.
He will have a get together at Alfitr.
I will visit my friend on Flag day.
The Saudi flight is due on the morning of June 25.
She usually wakes up at six o'clock.
She will get married at the age of 25.
prepositions_place: The children are playing in the living room.
Ahmad's house is on the third floor.
Nuha bought a new house in Jeddah.
We saw him on Alnajah street.
We used to play in the garden.
article_examples: An honest friend is a treasure indeed.
We saw a plane in the sky.
Riyadh is the capital of Saudi Arabia. (the for specific)
adjective_preposition: The judge said that the man isn't guilty of the crime.
He isn't aware of what is happening around him.
Nobody is enthusiastic about the new project.
She is jealous of any woman talking to her husband.
She is a bad doctor. She isn't worthy of respect.
That area is full of insects.
Is having food essential for taking medicine?
He isn't absolutely positive about the movie.
She is not obedient to her mother.
She was completely amazed at the news.
